This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  M/S R.RAJASEKHARAN PILLAI, SABINA JAYAN Advocates for the petitioner and  of the SENIOR GOVERNMENT PLEADER for Respondents (By Order), the court  passed the following:
 ORDER

An adjournment is sought at the instance of the Learned Senior Government Pleader appearing for the Revenue Department to get instructions especially regarding the proceedings which is stated to be pending consideration before the Apex Court.
